issues.title: Ingest Chicot County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $11,262,840 across 31 funds. The largest: County General Fund ($3,712,437), County Road ($3,704,701), Chicot Mem Med Center Operation & Maint ($1,605,000). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
